selection.reason: Among candidates without additional noise words, quiet-gain32 and quiet-gain128 tie: one fewer error on tune (72/577 vs 73/577), unchanged development (78/384). Choose the smaller gain; primary-clean variants hallucinate on at least one tuning background; retry variants do not improve WER. Separate 8-background amplitude sweep: 0 vs 0 words. All speech controls remain undecoded at freeze.
selection.retention_rule: Retain only if improvement repeats on independent control data, no extra speech errors on original OpenSTT/Golos, no new noise words, no worsened numeric/negation counts. No retuning after final controls.

Open control only for selected candidate. Keep runtime change only if control independently improves and repeats. JVM speed is not phone speed.
